phrases.text: You finally find the right job.
phrases.instruct: Excited and hopeful, like sharing good news with a friend.
Dry and deadpan, with a hint of a smile.

phrases.text: and you're buried in the pile.
Apply on the company's own site,
phrases.instruct: Brighter, leaning in, like sharing a good tip.

phrases.text: and you're almost twice as likely to get an interview.
phrases.instruct: Confident and impressed, letting the number land.
Bright and proud, with a warm smile.

phrases.text: Every hour, it checks over two hundred thousand of them.
phrases.instruct: Confident and lively, with a little wonder in the voice.

phrases.text: So you see new jobs early.

phrases.instruct: Playful and confident, with a big warm smile.
